create_graph_from_constraint: create a Graph from a Constraint list describing how stones transform by potions in latent space
convert_graph_to_adj_mat: convert a Graph object to a numpy adjacency matrix with potion indices at connected entries
possible_constraints: generate all valid Constraint lists where every node is reachable in the resulting graph
graph_distr: compute a prior probability distribution over all valid Graph objects given a sequence of constraints
partial_graph_from_graph: convert a fully known Graph into a PartialGraph with all edges marked as KNOWN_EDGE
